plan.summary: Add All the Way (2014) to commercial.json: recouped its $3.9M investment by May 31, 2014 (BroadwayWorld, Jun 5, 2014; CBS News/Reuters gives the same figure). Found by Gemini Deep Research and checked at the source. Left out: Proof (2000) recoupment, whose only source is a fan-site copy of a Theatre.com item.

entry.recoupedSource: BroadwayWorld (Jun 5, 2014): "As of May 31st, 2014, the Tony Award-nominated Broadway production of All the Way ... has recouped its investment of $3.9 million."
entry.notes: Limited run at the Neil Simon (opened Mar 6, 2014; closed Jun 29, 2014) starring Bryan Cranston as LBJ. Recouped its $3.9M capitalization by May 31, 2014; won the Tony for Best Play.
